blurb: For families in East Dallas, particularly those in the White Rock Lake and Lakewood areas, discovering a local dance studio that combines professional instruction with a fun and nurturing environment is a true find. AD Dance, also known as the Amanda Dalton School of Dance, has been serving this community since 2007, establishing itself as a beloved neighborhood dance school.
